headline: Transformers and Rectifiers shares jump 13% after Q2 results
hook: Strong quarterly growth drives share price rally
summary: Transformers and Rectifiers (India) Ltd shares rose over 13% to Rs 344 following the release of its second-quarter earnings. The company's market capitalization increased to Rs 10,369 crore. The stock rally reflects positive market sentiment toward the firm's latest financial performance.
why_it_matters: Positive earnings momentum boosts valuation for existing shareholders.

headline: Transformers & Rectifiers shares surge 10% on PM-DHARA scheme approval
hook: Transmission infrastructure push fuels power stock rally
summary: Shares of Transformers & Rectifiers India Ltd (TARIL) rose over 10% following the government's approval of the PM-DHARA scheme. The initiative allocates ₹1.36 lakh crore toward upgrading national transmission infrastructure. The company is currently benefiting from a strong order book in the nuclear sector and expanded manufacturing capacity. This policy support aims to address the rising demand for power transformers across the country.
why_it_matters: Increased government spending on grid infrastructure boosts power equipment manufacturers.
winners_losers: Power equipment makers gain / consumers unaffected
